verified_dimensions.formula: baseRawLength=(III?33:51)+4*extraLength; width=(III?15:21)+2*extraWidth; minOdd=ceil(width*3.6), add 1 if even; actualLength=max(baseRawLength,minOdd); extraLength 0..3, extraWidth 0..2

verified_IV.halfBeam: z∈[-L/2,L/2], half=W/2; z>=end-12: max(2,round(2+(half-2)*sin(pi/2*max(0,(end-z)/12)))); z<=-end+8: max(3,round(3+(half-3)*sin(pi/2*max(0,(end+z)/8)))); otherwise half

hybrid_level.cargo_candidate: on y=7, 2<=|x|<=halfBeam-4, only if ShipModularBlockHull.movingCargoCell approves AND cell not within corridor/stair/door/helm/mast/gun clearance; never clear existing cargo on upgrade
hybrid_level.fixtures: use existing lantern palette suspended from actual y=11 ceiling support, avoid intersections with 2-block player bounding volume and stairs
